Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Matthew Portraits
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portrait of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9764]Matthew - Custom NPC[/url] mod Character Matthew, Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. 

*Make sure you have PyTK mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)*
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]
Find where you installed your Matthew mod (some where in Stardew Valley\Mods folder)
Drag the "[CP] Matthew Original NPC" folder from my Zip into the Stardew Valley\Mods\Matthew Original NPC folder to overwrite the "[CP] Matthew Original NPC" folder in it.

This mod replaces the default portrait of Matthew.
If the portraits is not showing, please make sure the folder overwrites the correct files.


Uploaded CP version.
*I would still recommend the replacement file version as the assets don't get loaded 2 times and are lighter to run.

Added a new version in the optional file for people who want to install the portraits with portraiture.



Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9764]Matthew - Custom NPC[/url] mod.)

The characters belong to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9764]Matthew - Custom NPC[/url]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/119582738]Krayon4k[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
